fusions.name: Sweeping Tines
fusions.desc: Rakes a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 9 damage, up to 2.2 times that at maximum range. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Leave It Tidy
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Clear the Ground
fusions.desc: When a condition on you runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
